name: Clearstream
shortDescription: Church messaging software for text messages, email, keywords, phone numbers, QR codes and tap-to-connect links using near-field communication (NFC).
suitableContexts: Churches evaluating dedicated SMS and email communication
Teams needing a separate messaging layer alongside a people database

pricing.summary: Clearstream publishes a 30-day trial and US-dollar plans based on outgoing-message credits, with email included.

startingPrice.qualifier: 1,250 monthly credits on the US plan shown by the supplier

tiers.label: Trial
tiers.detail: 100 credits, one phone number and unlimited email on the US plan shown

tiers.label: Starter paid tier
tiers.detail: 1,250 credits and one phone number on the US plan shown

tiers.label: Growth tier
tiers.detail: 2,500 credits, two subaccounts and three phone numbers on the US plan shown

tiers.label: Higher-volume tiers
tiers.detail: Credits, subaccounts and phone numbers scale by plan

pricing.trialDetails: 30 days; supplier says no contract or setup fee.

support: Chat, email, phone and Zoom support

editorial.assessment: Clearstream is a messaging layer, not a replacement for a governed church people database. UK churches should obtain supplier evidence for number availability, message delivery, costs, consent, opt-out and PECR responsibilities before importing contacts.
bestFor: Churches that need intentional text-message journeys
Teams keeping their system of record elsewhere
strengths: Credit-based pricing and 30-day trial are published
limitations: UK SMS compliance and availability require supplier evidence

longForm.verdict: Clearstream is worth considering when messaging is a real operational discipline rather than an occasional broadcast. Its value depends on contact consent, integration and message-volume planning.

decisionLens.heading: A texting platform must not become an ungoverned contact list.
decisionLens.text: Before importing contacts, define who owns consent, opt-outs, sender numbers, message approval and the relationship with the church’s main people database.

sections.heading: Cost follows outgoing messages
sections.question: How many meaningful messages will the church actually send?
paragraphs: Clearstream’s published plans use outgoing-message credits while email is included. It also offers a thirty-day trial.
Model normal communications, event reminders and emergency messages. Confirm UK pricing and delivery before treating US-published credit allowances as a local quote.

userFeedback.summary: This profile is based on Clearstream’s published pricing and product information, not an independent review score.
themes: Credit use should be modelled against real communication habits.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier claims do not establish PECR or UK GDPR compliance for a particular church.

faq.question: Does Clearstream have a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. Clearstream advertises a 30-day trial with a stated credit allowance and one phone number on its US plan.

faq.question: How is Clearstream priced?
faq.answer: The supplier publishes US-dollar plans based on outgoing-message credits, starting at $29/month in its US pricing view.

faq.question: Can a UK church use Clearstream for SMS?
faq.answer: This profile does not confirm UK availability or compliance. Check number provision, delivery, costs, PECR and opt-out requirements directly.
